description: Implementation of AppManager class handling app lifecycle, properties, package management, and event dispatching within WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: AppManagerImplementation
classes.description: Implements app lifecycle management, property handling, package management, event dispatching, and telemetry within WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for app events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification callback.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event with parameters to the worker pool.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Handles various app events and notifies registered observers.

methods.name: handleOnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Notifies clients of app lifecycle state changes.

methods.name: handleOnAppUnloaded
methods.description: Notifies clients when an app is unloaded.

methods.name: handleOnAppLaunchRequest
methods.description: Notifies clients of app launch requests.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Initializes the AppManager with the provided service, sets up remote objects, and starts worker thread.

methods.name: createPersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Creates remote store object for persistent storage.

methods.name: releasePersistentStoreRemoteStoreObject
methods.description: Releases the persistent store remote object.

methods.name: createPackageManagerObject
methods.description: Creates package manager remote objects.

methods.name: releasePackageManagerObject
methods.description: Releases package manager remote objects.

methods.name: createStorageManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Creates storage manager remote object with retries.

methods.name: releaseStorageManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Releases storage manager remote object.

methods.name: createOrUpdatePackageInfoByAppId
methods.description: Creates or updates package info for a given app ID.

methods.name: removeAppInfoByAppId
methods.description: Removes package info for a given app ID.

methods.name: packageLock
methods.description: Locks the package for an app, fetching package list and updating info.

methods.name: packageUnLock
methods.description: Unlocks the package for an app.

methods.name: LaunchApp
methods.description: Requests app launch via lifecycle connector.

methods.name: CloseApp
methods.description: Requests app close via lifecycle connector.

methods.name: TerminateApp
methods.description: Requests app termination and unlocks package.

methods.name: KillApp
methods.description: Kills the app process and unlocks package.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves list of loaded apps.

methods.name: SendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to an app.

methods.name: PreloadApp
methods.description: Preloads an app into the running state.

methods.name: GetAppProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value for an app.

methods.name: SetAppProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value for an app.

methods.name: fetchAppPackageList
methods.description: Fetches list of installed app packages.

methods.name: getInstallAppType
methods.description: Returns string representation of application type.

methods.name: GetInstalledApps
methods.description: Retrieves list of installed apps with details.

methods.name: checkIsInstalled
methods.description: Checks if an app is installed.

methods.name: IsInstalled
methods.description: Public method to check installation status of an app.

methods.name: StartSystemApp
methods.description: Stub for starting system app.

methods.name: StopSystemApp
methods.description: Stub for stopping system app.

methods.name: ClearAppData
methods.description: Clears app data via storage manager.

methods.name: ClearAllAppData
methods.description: Clears all app data via storage manager.

methods.name: GetAppMetadata
methods.description: Stub for retrieving app metadata.

methods.name: GetMaxRunningApps
methods.description: Returns maximum number of running apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedApps
methods.description: Returns maximum number of hibernated apps.

methods.name: GetMaxHibernatedFlashUsage
methods.description: Returns max hibernated flash usage.

methods.name: GetMaxInactiveRamUsage
methods.description: Returns max inactive RAM usage.

methods.name: OnAppInstallationStatus
methods.description: Handles app installation status JSON responses.

methods.name: getCustomValues
methods.description: Reads custom values from file and updates runtime config.

methods.name: updateCurrentAction
methods.description: Updates current action for an app.

methods.name: updateCurrentActionTime
methods.description: Updates timestamp for current action (telemetry).
